display.purpose: Page-level headings and the recommended-pick headline.

body.purpose: Default running text, stat descriptions, card copy.

label.purpose: Badges, status chips, section eyebrows — always JetBrains Mono, uppercase.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Default card/panel elevation at rest — nearly imperceptible by design.

shadows.name: hover
shadows.purpose: Card hover state, paired with a -2px lift.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Genuinely floating surfaces only — modals, command palette.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition easing for hover/state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action — solid Signal Ember fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: #ec3013; color: #ffffff; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #dd2b0f; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ec3013; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(32,30,29,0.12); border-radius: 10px; background: #ffffff; color: #201e1d; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 200ms, background 200ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(32,30,29,0.24); background: #eae7e7; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ec3013; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Win Badge
components.description: Pill status chip, semantic tone example (win).
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; border-width: 1px; border-style: solid; } .ds-badge--win { color: #157a4a; border-color: rgba(21,122,74,0.3); background: rgba(21,122,74,0.12); }

narrative.overview:
Footy Predictor Pro is built like a serious bettor's private tracking sheet, not a tipster's billboard. Warm paper tones carry the surface; one disciplined ember-red accent is spent sparingly on the things that deserve attention (the pick headline, the primary action, the active nav item); three independent semantic inks — win-green, loss-wine, value-amber — carry outcome and edge information without borrowing the brand accent's weight. Nothing shouts. The interface states a probability, a result, or an edge plainly and gets out of the way; accuracy history and a calm presentation are what earn trust, not confident-sounding copy or decorative flourish.

The voice is confident and unembellished: no exclamation-point energy, no "guaranteed" language, no gamified flourish. This is explicitly not a flashy tipster-site look — restraint is the differentiator from that category, in the same way live in-match intelligence is the product differentiator.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral paper background, not stark white or cool gray — the surface itself feels like a physical ledger page.
A single brand accent (ember red-orange in light mode, shifting to green in dark mode) used only for signal: primary actions, the active nav state, the pick headline's emphasis.

Three semantic inks (win-green, loss-wine, value-amber) are structurally independent from the brand accent — a loss is never rendered in the same hue as the brand, and a value-bet callout is never confused with a generic warning.
Structural, flat-by-default elevation: shadows are nearly invisible at rest and deepen only on hover, focus, or true stacking (modals).

One typeface family (Archivo) carries both display and body text through weight and size alone, with JetBrains Mono reserved for numeric/label contexts (odds, stats, badges) — a ledger's columnar precision, not a second decorative face.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Ember appears on primary actions, the active nav item, and the pick headline's emphasis only — never as a background fill for informational content, and never for a settled win/loss outcome.

rules.name: The Independent Ink Rule
rules.body: Win Green, Loss Wine, and Value Amber never borrow each other's role. A value-bet callout is not a "warning," and a loss is not rendered as if it were an error state.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any figure a user compares against another figure renders with tabular-nums or JetBrains Mono — never proportional digits.

rules.name: The Earned Depth Rule
rules.body: A shadow deeper than Resting must be justified by an actual interaction state or genuine z-stacking — never applied to a resting in-flow element for visual richness.

rules.name: The Three-Step Rule
rules.body: Every rounded surface uses exactly one of 10 / 16 / 20px — never an ad-hoc radius value.

dos: Do spend Signal Ember only on primary actions, the active nav state, and the pick headline's emphasis.
Do keep Win Green / Loss Wine / Value Amber structurally independent.
Do use JetBrains Mono or tabular-nums for any figure the user will compare against another figure.
Do keep shadows flat at rest and let hover/focus/stacking earn depth.
Do use exactly one of the three radius steps (10 / 16 / 20px) for any new rounded surface.
Do enforce the 44px minimum touch target on every interactive control.
donts: Don't introduce the legacy --lab-* token set, the plain unprefixed --bg/--accent/--border variables in src/index.css, or the Tailwind-config atelier/frost/card-hover shadow tokens in new work.
Don't reuse the teal rgba(62, 207, 191, *) focus-ring color still hardcoded on global input/select focus-visible states.
Don't let rounded-xl/rounded-2xl Tailwind defaults slip into new components as a substitute for the tokenized 10/16/20px scale.
Don't apply a resting shadow heavier than the Resting token to an in-flow card for visual interest.
Don't brighten Loss Wine toward a pure alarm red or brighten Win Green toward a saturated neon.
